300 MMA Training Center (San Salvador)
summary: MMA gym listed at Colonia Las Mercedes, calle Los Granados 175, with 4.9 stars from 29 reviews on Gym Navigator. No website, timetable, coach names or fighter roster could be found, so level and sparring are unverified.
requirements: unknown, ask by message before travelling

details.visitors: unknown, Spanish is the safe assumption
details.neighbourhood: Colonia Escalon or Santa Elena for quiet streets, Antiguo Cuscatlan for modern flats (nomad.watch AI guide, unchecked)
details.water_note: Pacific beaches at La Libertad and El Tunco are about 30 km straight line, roughly an hour by bus. Coordinates here are the city centre, not the gym.
details.score_note: Training 5 is a cautious guess for a named MMA gym with no roster found. Cost uses a 1 bedroom outside the centre at 385 USD, a generic gym at 33 USD and 3 cheap meals at 15 USD a day, USD x 6.45.

name: Fight Club El Salvador (San Salvador)
summary: Team name that appears as the affiliation of a Salvadoran amateur MMA fighter on Sherdog. No address, website or recent activity was found, so treat it as a lead to ask about, not a confirmed gym.

details.fighters: Carlos Gutierrez, 0-0 pro, one amateur loss at Panama Fight League Fight Night 16 on 27 Nov 2020 (Sherdog)
details.water_note: Pacific coast about 30 km straight line from the city centre. Position is a placeholder at the city centre.
details.score_note: One old Sherdog affiliation and nothing else, so evidence is 1 and training is a low guess. Costs as for San Salvador, USD x 6.45.

dec_jan: unknown, its fighter was active in Dec 2024 and Sep 2025

details.fighters: Francisco Navarro, amateur, 5 fights 2023 to 2025 (UCC 61, GAMMA Central American Championships 2023, 501 Belize Fight Night 6, UCC 72, UCC 78) per Sherdog
details.neighbourhood: not researched, no source on San Pedro Sula neighbourhoods was fetched
details.water_note: Puerto Cortes on the Caribbean is about 39 km straight line. Position is a placeholder at the city centre.
details.score_note: Recent competing fighter but no gym page or reviews. Costs from TravelTables Jul 2023: 1 bedroom outside centre 294 USD, fitness club 48.59 USD, meals 5 USD, USD x 6.45.

name: Ludus Cerberus MMA (Tegucigalpa)

details.score_note: Old evidence only (last seen 2023). Costs from TravelTables Jul 2023: 1 bedroom outside centre 278 USD, fitness club 41.25 USD, meals 4.5 USD, USD x 6.45.

name: San Salvador: training base scorecard
summary: San Salvador has one named MMA gym, 300 MMA Training Center in Colonia Las Mercedes (4.9 stars, 29 reviews on Gym Navigator), and nothing else I could verify for muay thai or kickboxing. The national scene is growing, with a new pro combat sports commission in June 2025, but I found no gym page, roster or sparring report. Treat it as a base only if you message gyms first.
dec_jan: El Salvador is in its dry season in December and January. No gym holiday closures found.

details.neighbourhoods: Colonia Escalon, Santa Elena or Antiguo Cuscatlan per nomad.watch (AI guide, unchecked). The gym is in Colonia Las Mercedes.
details.safety: Not verified in this pass. nomad.watch (AI guide) names San Benito (Zona Rosa) as the safe nightlife area.
details.water_note: Pacific at La Libertad and El Tunco about 30 km straight line, about an hour by bus.
details.local_life: Residential capital neighbourhood and Spanish is the working language, but nothing confirms who trains there.

name: El Tunco / El Zonte / La Libertad coast: training base scorecard
area: El Tunco / El Zonte / La Libertad coast
summary: I found no verified combat gym on the coast. A directory page lists a Tunco Muay Thai & Fitness but it is an AI generated guide with no source, and the only real lead is a Brazilian jiu jitsu or self defence class for 10 USD run by a Performance Academy in El Zonte as part of a retreat. Good for surf and a break, not for a serious striking block.
dec_jan: Dry season. El Tunco is loud on Friday and Saturday nights, El Zonte is calm.

details.neighbourhoods: El Zonte for calm, El Tunco for backpacker bars (visitelsalvador.ai, 2025). Dorm beds 8 to 15 USD a night.
details.safety: nomad.watch (AI guide) rates El Tunco 6.5 of 10 and mentions petty theft, so unverified.
details.local_life: Tourist surf strip. Pupuserias at 0.5 to 1 USD each and comedores at 3 to 5 USD give a cheap food base.

name: San Pedro Sula: training base scorecard
summary: XFit MMA Academy is the only team I could tie to the city, through one amateur fighter who competed on Panama Fight League cards as late as Sep 2025. There is no website, timetable or review count I could reach, so this is a thin lead. The Honduran cards I could verify were held in Tegucigalpa.
dec_jan: No December weather source fetched. The local XFit fighter competed on 7 Dec 2024 and 6 Sep 2025.

details.safety: Not verified in this pass, check current travel advisories.
details.water_note: Puerto Cortes about 39 km straight line.
details.local_life: Spanish speaking commercial city, but nothing confirms who trains there.

name: Tegucigalpa: training base scorecard
summary: Tegucigalpa hosts the Honduran MMA cards (UCC 74 on 7 Mar 2025, UCC 77 on 31 May 2025, UCC 82 on 13 Dec 2025 at RadioHouse Casa Campo), so a fight scene exists. The only team I could name is Ludus Cerberus MMA, last seen in 2023, and no gym page or reviews turned up. A May 2026 embassy report calls crime rampant and discourages walking alone, which counts against a long stay.
dec_jan: Cards ran in Tegucigalpa in December (UCC 82 on 13 Dec 2025), so the local scene is active then.

details.neighbourhoods: Not researched. Embassy staff live in gated neighbourhoods within about 8 km of the embassy.
details.safety: Embassy post report 2026-05: crime described as rampant, two robberies at gunpoint among people the author knows, avoid walking alone, keep a low profile.
details.water_note: Inland. Gulf of Fonseca about 78 km straight line.
details.local_life: Local capital with no backpacker scene found. The most popular gym named in the embassy report costs about 100 USD a month.

name: Utila: training base scorecard
summary: I found no martial arts gym on Utila. Sources describe small local gyms and resort fitness rooms at 5 to 10 USD a visit. It is a diving island, so train elsewhere and come here for the water.
dec_jan: Rainy season runs October to January on the Bay Islands (nomadlio guide for Roatan), so December can be wet.

details.safety: nomad.watch (AI guide) gives no crime data. It notes power cuts, cash shortages and evacuation to the mainland for serious medical cases.
details.local_life: Dive tourism island. nomad.watch (AI guide) quotes simple monthly apartments at 500 to 1200 USD, which is unverified.

name: Roatan: training base scorecard
summary: No combat gym found on Roatan. Gyms listed are Roatan Gym and CrossFit Roatan, and nomadlio rates martial arts there 3 of 10. A Roberto Cyborg Abreu jiu jitsu retreat ran 2 to 5 Apr 2026 at Prospera, a one off, not a regular gym.
dec_jan: Rainy season October to January with storm risk (nomadlio).

details.safety: nomadlio (AI guide) notes inflated taxi fares, petty theft and limited healthcare.
details.local_life: Tourist and expat island with higher prices than the mainland. No cost figures could be sourced.

name: Lobo Gym / Team Grasso (Guadalajara)
area: Guadalajara, Tlajomulco (Santa Anita, Lopez Mateos Sur)
summary: Francisco Grasso's fight team and the home of UFC fighters Alexa Grasso, Diego Lopes, Alessandro Costa, Loopy Godinez and Irene Aldana. Pro level striking, wrestling and BJJ, but the current address, price and whether paying amateur visitors get into sparring are not confirmed. Coordinates are approximate for the Tapology address.
dec_jan: unknown. Fighters have bouts on 21 Nov and 12 Dec 2026 (Combat Edge), so the team is active in December.
requirements: Not published. Contact the gym first. A foreign visitor reported 3 weeks of training and being invited back, so visitors appear possible.

details.coaches: Francisco 'Pancho' Grasso head coach (uncle of Alexa Grasso). Luis Grasso also leads. Diego Lopes helps coach BJJ (EssentiallySports 2024).
details.fighters: Alexa Grasso (UFC, 18-5-1), Diego Lopes (28-8, UFC 335 on 12 Dec 2026 vs Oliveira), Alessandro Costa (17-5), Loopy Godinez (15-6), Irene Aldana. Combat Edge rates 4 active fighters. Next-fight.com lists 29 fighters and 1 coach.
details.timetable: A 2023 visitor trained 9 pm to 1 am and sometimes 2 or 3 sessions a day (Squamish Chief). No published timetable found.
details.sparring: Team sparring with UFC level fighters is described (Aldana is Grasso's main sparring partner). Access for paying amateur visitors not confirmed.
details.visitors: Not published. One Canadian female fighter trained 3 weeks and was invited back (Squamish Chief, undated 2023). Spanish helps.
details.address_note: Tapology (2026 page fetched 2026-10-30): Av. Lopez Mateos Sur 5565 Local D2, Plaza Provenza Santa Anita, Tlajomulco, CP 45645, phone 044 33 1094 2345. ESPN Deportes (Jan 2021) put the gym on Periferico Poniente in Zapopan, so it has moved or there are two sites. Current address NOT confirmed. Facebook page: TeamGrassoJalisco.
details.last_activity: 2026-10 Combat Edge roster page (fights 21 Nov and 12 Dec 2026)
details.neighbourhood: If the Santa Anita address is right: Tlajomulco / Santa Anita on the road toward Lake Chapala, car or bus needed. Not verified.
details.water_note: Lake Chapala is roughly 40 minutes by road from Santa Anita (general knowledge, not sourced).
details.score_note: Elite team but price, current address and visitor sparring unverified. Cost 6 is an estimate: Expatistan average gym is MXN 1,142 per month, about 410 DKK at 0.36 DKK per MXN. No room price found.

name: Guadalajara: training base scorecard
summary: Guadalajara has one elite striking and MMA address in Lobo Gym / Team Grasso, home to several UFC fighters, but its current address, price and visitor policy are unconfirmed and it sits in Tlajomulco, outside the city core. Other gyms found (Black Martials, MMA Sportcenter) have only aggregator listings. Samurai Gym and the Reynoso boxing gym could not be verified, so Simon should message Lobo Gym before committing.
dec_jan: Dry and mild, daytime about 24 to 26 C and cool nights (general knowledge, not sourced).

details.neighbourhoods: Not verified. Near Lobo Gym's Santa Anita address that would be Tlajomulco or the Chapala road. Zapopan for Black Martials and MMA Sportcenter.
details.water_note: Lake Chapala and Ajijic are roughly 45 to 60 minutes from Guadalajara by bus or car (general knowledge).
details.local_life: Big Mexican city with strong fight culture (boxing, lucha, MMA) but the best gym is a suburban plaza.

name: Lake Chapala / Ajijic: training base scorecard
summary: No striking or MMA gym was verified in Chapala or Ajijic, because the research ran out of search budget before this town was covered. Ajijic is an expat town on the lake, so it is a water bonus but probably a foreigner bubble. Best use is living there and commuting to Lobo Gym, whose Santa Anita address is on the way, which is unverified.

details.water_note: Lake Chapala is on the doorstep.

name: Zona De Combate (Medellin)
summary: Two-floor MMA, BJJ and striking gym with a cage in central El Poblado, visited by a BJJ Globetrotters writer in March 2025. Only thinly documented online so far: no sparring schedule, fighter list or monthly price found.
requirements: Bring your own gloves (blog, 2024). Sparring rules unknown.

details.coaches: Jorge MMA 12 (private lessons, blog 2024). Coach Sebas teaches wrestling (BJJ Globetrotters, March 2025).

what_people_say.quote: I was impressed with the instruction

details.water_note: No sea or lake in Medellin. Guatape lake is a day trip.
details.score_note: Provisional. Only two first-hand blog mentions found, no ratings, price or sparring info. Coordinates are approximate from the street address.
